rule: An msiexec install step removes when any argument does. An argument is split on whitespace into pieces; each piece is trimmed, rid of one pair of surrounding double quotes, trimmed again; it removes when it matches ^[/-](x|uninstall) or ^remove=, ASCII case-insensitively and nothing else (no Unicode case folding). Implemented by the server (app/features/package/manifest.py), the agent (agent/internal/deploy) and deploy/packages/Sign-TiaiPackage.ps1.
whitespace: What Python's str.split() and Go's unicode.IsSpace plus U+001C-U+001F agree on: U+0009-000D, 001C-001F, 0020, 0085, 00A0, 1680, 2000-200A, 2028, 2029, 202F, 205F, 3000. Zero-width characters (U+200B, U+FEFF) are not whitespace.
each_entry: one argument of the install step
